Three Simple Steps To Enter An Affordable Apartment Lottery

01

Determine Your Eligibility

An applicant’s eligibility is determined according to his/her annual income and household size. The allowed annual income range varies per the specifications for each project. Use our handy eligibility checker tool.

02

Create Housing Connect Account

The Affordable Marketing lotteries or conducted by the New York City Housing Preservation Development (HPD). create an account with HPD’s “Housing Connect” website to enter a lottery.

03

Apply Through Housing Connect

Once your account is set up with Housing Connect you can easily apply to your desired apartment.
